messages:
sam: Opening PR #8405 — allocator: adjust batch-horizon logic. Canary shows a 10-20% p95 tail regression on longseq. attaching bench artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/8405

sam: Short summary:
```
baseline p95 (4k seq, A100-like profile): 98ms
canary   p95 (post-change)   : 115ms
memory: baseline peak 2.1GB -> canary peak 2.25GB (transient)
observed: tail tokens spike around prefill->generation handoff
```

sam: Requesting a quick second-opinion before we merge to main — suspect kv-cache prefill ordering change is the culprit. @jen @alex @kai

jen: pinging perf folks :eyes: do you have the raw bench command and logs? also which canary pool did this run on?

sam: bench command I used:
```bash
./bench/run_batch.sh --model redwood-v1 --seq 4096 --batch 8 --warmup 100 --steps 500 --track-kv --artifacts out/8405
```
logs: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/8405/logs.txt
canary pool: canary-gpu-4 (dev-tier)

alex: i'll reproduce locally on my 4xA100 setup in ~30m. quick question: do we see sustained memory growth or a transient spike?

kai: i pulled the canary traces. there's a ~120ms latency slab at the prefill boundary and a ~100-200MB transient mem bump for some shards. flamegraph: https://graphs.redwood/8405-flame.svg

deploy-bot: Canary deployment canary-2026-07-10-22:04 failed healthcheck on 3/12 hosts — automatic rollback initiated. (CI artifact attached)

maria: if it's the prefill ordering, can we gate it behind a per-route flag so we can disable for high-latency routes as a mitigation?

sam: yes — we already have `--prefill-mode` feature flag. current default is `eager`. quick config snippet:
```yaml
runtime:
  prefill-mode: eager   # options: eager|sampling|disabled
```
we can flip to `sampling` or `disabled` per-route in config to reduce prefill pressure.

alex: i ran the bench with `prefill-mode=disabled` locally. quick numbers: p95 -> 101ms, peak mem stable at ~2.12GB. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/8405/local-run-1

alex: so turning prefill off basically recovers most of the regression. seems consistent with a prefill interaction.

jen: good mitigation. i'd be comfortable with a merge if we ship the flag change (default stays `eager` in main until we decide) and add a small e2e that exercises prefill off path. also request a 2nd approval per process.

sam: will push a small follow-up that exposes route-level toggle and a smoke e2e. requesting @maria for second approval. aiming for merge window at 12:00 UTC if green.

maria: lgtm for gating and the e2e. i'll give +1 once CI finishes. please add note in PR description about canary rollback and mitigation steps.

jen: i'll schedule a canary run on dedicated pool with `prefill-mode=disabled` post-merge to validate at scale.

sam: thanks all — i'll update PR with test, config snippet, and the mitigation playbook. will also attach the repro command and quick diff of artifacts.

sam: (action items)
- sam: push follow-up patch w/ route flag + e2e
- alex: run scaled canary with flag off once merged
- jen: schedule dedicated canary run
- maria: +1 after CI

sam: tagging the PR with "hold:canary-fail" and adding notes to the incident doc for traceability.

sam: thanks everyone :pray:
